「你跑的时候，队友去哪儿？」: “Where do your teammates go as you run?”

新增和修改只保留在本次打开的网页里。离开前点「保存完整战术包」，下次打开后再导入: Imported changes last for this session. Save the complete playbook before leaving, then import it next time.

从左侧选一条，找找自己的字母。: Choose a lesson and find your player’s letter.

看这套战术的目标和自己的配合任务，再点击关键帧停住讲解。: Read the play’s goal and your role, then pause at keyframes to talk it through.
回到站位，换一名队员，让孩子用手指画路线。: Reset, choose another player and trace the route with a finger.
点击关键帧或拖动进度会暂停；按「继续播放」从那里接着走。连续播放经过关键帧不会自: Selecting a keyframe or seeking pauses the scene. Resume from there; ordinary playback does not stop at keyframes.
部分战术依据官方讲解安排先后，具体动画秒数仍是教学示意。有条件的路线需先选择演示: Some start relationships follow the official explanations, but exact seconds are illustrative. Choose a situation before demonstrating conditional routes. The app does not judge defenders or choose a pass target. A player with no later route stays at the known position; this is not an instruction to stand still.
自己编战术：下载模板 → 用文本编辑器修改 → 导入预览 → 保存完整战术包。教: Create a play: download the template → edit the text → import and preview → save the complete playbook. Lessons work offline; source links and videos need a connection when opened.
按 Esc 关闭弹窗。恢复内置手册或重新打开网页后，需要重新载入自己保存的战术包: Press Esc to close. After restoring the built-in playbook or reopening the page, import your saved playbook again.
没有找到，试试英文跑法或页码。: No results. Try a route name or page number.

本应用的教学图例: Teaching legend used in this app
本应用教学图例 · 点击场内动作标记，停下来讲解: Our teaching legend · Click an action marker to pause and explain
进攻战术可切换 C、X、Y、Z 四个接球目标，跑球可选择交接或跑传情形。彩色实线: Offensive plays offer C, X, Y and Z as receiving targets; running plays offer handoff or run/pass scenarios. Colored arrows show player routes, orange dashes show passes or snaps, and white trails show where the ball has been carried. An open circle marks a handoff; FAKE marks a fake handoff or pump fake with no change of possession. Click an action marker on the field to pause at that moment. Markers show Upcoming, Now or Done. Switching scenarios resets and pauses. Turn off Show ball to see the source routes. These symbols, timings and added ball sequences are teaching conventions used in this app; the app does not read the defense.
